title: First description on female and tadpole of <i>Nidirana chongqingensis</i> Ma & Wang, 2023 (Anura, Ranidae) and its distribution expansion in Guizhou Province, China.

readScopes.readScope: Nidirana chongqingensis: Six adult and five larval vouchers at one Guizhou locality, mitochondrial attribution, female and staged-larval description, revised diagnosis, ecology and explicitly dated conservation discussion; earlier authored study retained; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
